Package com.hkust.marketplace.utils

Class SceneManager

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.utils.SceneManager
public class SceneManager extends Object
Central navigation helper. Loads FXML scenes and keeps a reference to the primary stage.

  • Method Details

    • init

      public static void init(javafx.stage.Stage stage)
      Initializes the navigation helper with the application's primary stage.

      Must be called on the JavaFX Application Thread before any switchScene(String) or show* helper. Calling it again replaces the stored stage, for example after the window is recreated.

      Parameters:
      stage - primary stage used by all subsequent navigation calls

    • getPrimaryStage

      public static javafx.stage.Stage getPrimaryStage()
      Returns the stage registered by init(Stage).
      Returns:
      the primary stage, or null when init(Stage) has not been called

    • switchScene

      public static void switchScene(String fxmlName)
      Loads an FXML view from the classpath and shows it in the primary stage.

      The resource is resolved as /fxml/ plus fxmlName. On the first call a new Scene of 1200x780 is created and /css/styles.css is attached when available; later calls keep that scene and its stylesheets and only replace its root node. Failures (missing resource, FXML load error) are reported in a modal alert and rethrown wrapped in a RuntimeException. Must be called on the JavaFX Application Thread.

      Parameters:
      fxmlName - FXML file path relative to the /fxml/ resource directory, for example buyer/BuyerLoginView.fxml
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if the helper was not initialized, the resource is missing, or the view cannot be loaded
